scope_limits: Rootless Docker 29.8.0 tested offline in QEMU, UID 1000 daemon, vfs storage, network none.
The original firmware userspace has not gained rootless helpers, subordinate ID mappings or service management.
Rootless Docker resource flags require cgroup v2 and systemd delegation; the stock rc/cgroup v1 environment does not provide that integration.
Block read/write throttling validated with direct I/O. Buffered per-cgroup writeback, blkio low-latency policy and I/O latency controller remain disabled.
